sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Jay Prakash Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent, and perused the entire record.

2. This application has been filed with a prayer to quash the charge-sheet dated 19.11.2020, arising out of Case Crime No.0076 of 2020, under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of I.P.C. and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Collector Bookganj, District Bareilly, as well as Cognizance/summoning order dated 23.12.2020, on the basis of a compromise.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that since the parties had settled their dispute outside the court, therefore, concerned S.H.O. was directed to verify the compromise vide order dated 21.05.2025.

It is further submitted that since parties have settled the dispute, opposite party no.2 does not want to proceed with trial, therefore, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the matter pending.

sentences.text: 4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. submits that on verification, the fact has been found to be correct that the applicant has solemnized marriage with the victim/opposite party no.2.
Since the dispute between the parties has been settled and opposite party no.2 has no objection, therefore, the proceedings of the aforesaid case pending before the trial court be quashed.
5. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, and have gone through the entire record.

6. Since the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled, no fruitful purpose would be served by permitting to continue the criminal case pending before the trial court and it would simply a waste of judicial time as chances of conviction are very bleak.

7. In such circumstances, the entire proceedings ofcharge-sheet dated 19.11.2020, arising out of Case Crime No.0076 of 2020, under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of I.P.C. and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Collector Bookganj, District Bareilly, as well as Cognizance/summoning order dated 23.12.2020, Auraiya, against the applicant, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: Police Station Collector Bookganj, District Bareilly
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 8. The instant petition stands allowed, accordingly.
